correction_path: the repository owner accepts a source-linked ProjectModel and kernel update with evidence, invalidator and rollback

agentic_self_direction.active_object: the public MAIOS Conversation Kernel repository and its first ChatGPT adapter
agentic_self_direction.current_state: an accepted open-world direction with private internal proof and no public neutral implementation yet
eligible_actions: add source-bound public contracts and evals
agentic_self_direction.memory_delta_and_reentry: preserve accepted sources, current resultant, capability attestations, eval receipts and supersession conditions
agentic_self_direction.next_legal_movement: generate, inspect and publish the neutral source repository with claim-matched evals
agentic_self_direction.proof_required: deterministic generation, private-residue scan, public readback and bounded fresh-host challenges

user_possibility_horizon.consequential_decision: select and verify the first user-owned kernel incarnation without fixing the final product form
user_possibility_horizon.correction_or_none_of_these: The owner can revise the field, reject an adapter, retain an unknown or choose another resulting form.
user_possibility_horizon.expected_result_and_recovery: a public repository that can be forked, inspected, adapted and de-kernelized without losing source or state
possibilities_with_reasons: Own the kernel and state because continuity remains inspectable and exportable.
Use a minimal host adapter because the kernel should outlive one UI.
Let new faculties emerge because the initial capability map is a starting lens, not a ceiling.
user_possibility_horizon.situation_in_domain_language: A person can give conversational AI durable project continuity without turning one prompt, model or platform into the limit of the system.
user_possibility_horizon.unknowns_and_tradeoffs: Hosts expose unequal tools and memory; stronger effects require situated attestations and gates, while cognitive and design possibilities remain open.

work_orchestration_plan.authority_and_data_boundary: project-owned source writes and explicitly selected GitHub publication only; no implicit host, runtime, site or third-party effects
work_orchestration_plan.first_proof: a public fresh reader reconstructs identity, sources, open horizon, current state, adapter boundary and eval path without private context
work_orchestration_plan.how_to_do_it: compile the accepted ProjectModel, inspect generated output, add only owner-native public artifacts, validate determinism and residue boundaries, publish source and verify remote bytes
work_orchestration_plan.selected_need_or_hypothesis: prove that an open-world conversational kernel can remain coherent, user-owned and host-situated without a closed function catalog
work_orchestration_plan.stop_or_revise_condition: revise if the repository becomes a prompt dump, fixed catalog, private-state projection, false activation claim or high-latency ritual
work_orchestration_plan.what_to_do: generate the public Project Kernel, add replaceable adapter and capability contracts, publish it, then run positive and negative behavioral challenges
work_orchestration_plan.why_now: the internal kernel and installed adapter provide source evidence, while a public neutral proof is required before a MAIOS product page can make the capability inspectable

possibilities.invalidator: The generated kernel routes only through a fixed catalog or cannot preserve a source-bound unknown outside its represented families.
possibilities.rationale: A deep stable interface preserves coherence while leaving the capability field extensible.
possibilities.recheck_condition: A non-isomorphic task exposes an unrepresented material relation.
possibilities.smallest_proof: A fresh reader resolves one material relation outside the initial examples without inventing authority or losing source lineage.
possibilities.statement: One project-local meta-faculty can discover, compose, create, revise or retire situated faculties without treating its initial function families as a ceiling.

possibilities.invalidator: The kernel depends on hidden host memory or embeds one host's mechanics as universal identity.
possibilities.rationale: Host mechanics should change without cloning or reducing the kernel.
possibilities.recheck_condition: A second host adapter or a material ChatGPT platform change is evaluated.
possibilities.smallest_proof: ChatGPT uses the minimal adapter while all deeper state remains reconstructible from the repository.
possibilities.statement: The same user-owned capability core can be situated through ChatGPT and future conversational or agentic hosts using replaceable adapters and per-host attestations.

possibilities.invalidator: The preserved change is only a note, requires hidden transcript state or raises authority silently.
possibilities.rationale: Durable source and receipts keep evolution inspectable, reversible and portable.
possibilities.recheck_condition: A reusable correction is accepted or contradicted.
possibilities.smallest_proof: A reviewed correction changes a later non-isomorphic result while unrelated work remains direct.
possibilities.statement: Reviewed work can preserve reusable changes in the user's repository so future instances evolve without depending on the originating conversation.

problem_field.statement: Useful project state and causal continuity are easily fragmented across conversations, documents, repositories and host memory.

problem_field.invalidator: Independent situated use shows that the current form never constrains recognition, faculty composition or later evolution.
problem_field.recheck_condition: A host, model, tool surface or kernel representation changes materially.
problem_field.statement: A current chat interface, tool registry, prompt, model or capability catalog may be mistaken for the boundary of what the kernel can recognize or become.
Access, maturity, usefulness and authority can be fused, causing false capability claims or unauthorized effects.

review_or_supersession_condition: new host evidence, operator correction or a source-bound relation changes the current resultant
unknowns: which unrepresented faculty relation will first emerge in public use
how different conversational hosts will expose source and effect capabilities
which delivery and commercial relations will become material after public proof
